name: BrowseComp-ZH
intro: BrowseComp-ZH 是面向中文互联网原生构造的高难度网页浏览基准。10 位专家从可独立验证的短答案反向设计多跳问题，并经过难度和答案唯一性两阶段人工质检，将 480 条初始样本收敛为 289 道验证题。
org: HKUST(GZ), Peking University, Mindverse AI et al.
build_method: 专家反向构造与两阶段人工质检
eval_feature: 中文 Web, 多跳检索, 答案唯一性, 实时浏览
build_method_en: Expert Reverse Construction + Two-stage Human QC
eval_feature_en: Chinese Web, Multi-hop Retrieval, Answer Uniqueness, Live Browsing
intro_en: BrowseComp-ZH is a high-difficulty web-browsing benchmark natively constructed for the Chinese information ecosystem. Ten expert contributors reverse-designed multi-hop questions from independently verifiable short answers; two stages of human quality control reduced 480 initial samples to 289 verified questions.
drawio_review_note: Aligned with BrowseComp-ZH arXiv:2504.19314v1, Sections 3.1–3.2. The official PALIN2018/BrowseComp-ZH repository is pinned to commit 86abe635e7deef89ec00c68ff1c2588f0e2f2099. Its encrypted browsecomp-zh-encrypted.xlsx release has SHA-256 49963cdc8b4a16f4656bbac89ed5f3495f7b3bec4cf310990f567e7893c6a531. The diagram preserves the paper-disclosed 480 - 76 - 115 = 289 construction counts without inferring unpublished intermediate manifests or decryption provenance.
